mapper.select: SELECT FROM point_transaction WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND deleted=0 AND transaction_type=#{type} ORDER BY CASE WHEN transaction_type='EARN' THEN expire_time END ASC, create_time ASC
SELECT FROM point_transaction WHERE remain_amount>0 AND deleted=0 AND expire_time IS NOT NULL AND expire_time<=#{now} ORDER BY user_id,expire_time,id
mapper.update: UPDATE point_transaction SET remain_amount=remain_amount-#{amount} WHERE id=#{id} AND remain_amount >= #{amount}
UPDATE point_transaction SET remain_amount=0 WHERE id=#{id} AND remain_amount>0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM point_transaction WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND source_type=#{sourceType} AND source_id=#{sourceId} AND transaction_type='CONSUME' AND deleted=0
